project_title: Chest X-ray Review Priority: An Educational Cost-Based Triage Study

accepted_limitations: One representative source-reader box per present class; additional same-class regions may be unannotated. Localization metrics are not exhaustive lesion-detection metrics.
Source IDs identify images, not verified patients; patient independence is unproven.
Advanced similarity review established no copied image among the reviewed top 20 pairs, but one highly similar train/validation pair remains unresolved as possibly related acquisitions.
Source CSV is corroborated through a public mirror, not an authenticated official download.
No finding denotes absence of the 14 listed categories, not general health or clinical clearance.
dataset.user_decision: Choose chest X-rays for image-level priority triage; explicitly retain those limitations

framing.unit: one chest X-ray image, not a verified patient or complete examination
framing.positive: At least one of the 14 listed findings is annotated
framing.negative: None of the 14 listed findings is annotated; source labels explicitly say No finding
